info.name: Coveo Activity Activities Organization Privileges API

params.name: organizationId
params.description:
The unique identifier of the target [organization](https://docs.coveo.com/en/185/).
**Example:** `mycoveocloudv2organizationg8tp8wu3`

params.description: The access token for which to list privileges.

items.docs: List [privileges](https://docs.coveo.com/en/228/) of an access token in an [organization](https://docs.coveo.com/en/185/).

items.docs:
Lists the possible [privileges](https://docs.coveo.com/en/228/) in an [organization](https://docs.coveo.com/en/185/).

Privilege required ``` {"owner":"PLATFORM","targetDomain":"ORGANIZATION","type":"VIEW","targetId":"*"} ```
